contentList.content: Rage
Deal [1] extra damage with melee and improvised weapons, and throwing.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to physical damage, and <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Strength <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Frenzy

Your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> turns into a frenzy! You gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FrenziedStrike">Frenzied Strike</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_FrenziedThrow">Enraged Throw</LSTag>. You can also make an <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_ImprovisedWeaponBerserker">Improvised Weapon Attack</LSTag> as a bonus action.
Rage: Bear Heart
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> that makes you tough enough to stand up to any punishment.
You can use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_FerociousAppetite">Unrelenting Ferocity</LSTag>, and have Resistance to all damage except Psychic damage.
Rage: Eagle Heart
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> that makes you near untouchable.

You can use Diving Strike.

Foes also have Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use Dash as a bonus action.
Rage: Elk Heart
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> that grants you extraordinary swiftness.
You can use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Primal_Stampede">Primal Stampede</LSTag>, and your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> increases by [1].
Rage: Tiger Heart
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> that empowers your leaps.
You can use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_TigersBloodlust">Tiger's Bloodlust</LSTag>, and your jump distance increases by [1].
Rage: Wolf Heart
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> so inciting it spurs on your allies.

You can use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_PackHowl_Barbarian">Inciting Howl</LSTag>, and your allies have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on melee <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against enemies within [1] of you.
Invisibility
Become Invisible.
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> that releases all the magic roiling inside of you, causing a random magical effect.
Rage: Wild Magic
Giant's Rage
Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag> and increase in size. Your Rage damage bonus is doubled on Throw attacks.
Rage Ended
%%% Rage Mute
%%% Technical status; doesn't need to be destubbed.
Frenzied

Deals an additional [1] damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.

Also has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Frenzied Strain
Using Frenzied Strike adds a penalty to Attack Rolls every time, stacking so that you miss more often. This adds up until the end of your Frenzy.

Rage: Elk Heart

Deals an additional [1] damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.

Movement speed increased by [2].

Also has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Tiger Heart

Deals an additional [1] damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.

Jump distance increased by [2].

Also has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Wolf Heart

Deals an additional [1] damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.

Allies have Advantage on melee Attack Rolls against enemies within [2].

Also has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Wolf Heart's Prey

Standing near a Raging Wolf Heart barbarian.

The barbarian's allies have Advantage on melee attack rolls against this creature.
Rage Impeded

Weighed down by Heavy Armour. Until the armour is removed, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Raging</LSTag> won't grant extra damage, resistance to physical damage, or <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Strength <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
